pack.name: ARC-AMPE Architecture Themes (CMS ACA / Medicaid Partner Entities)
pack.description: Architecture-review themes aligned to CMS ARC-AMPE Volume I v1.02 (Pillars, ACA AE CSF Profile, Privacy Framework profile) with NIST SP 800-53 R5 control citations. Thematic mapping only; not CMS conformity, SSPP authoring, or attestation.

rules.title: Consumer engagement surfaces documented for informed enrollment decisions
rules.description: Exchange-facing portals, eligibility APIs, and partner enrollment channels must document how consumers receive clear plan and subsidy information before PII is collected — supporting ACA AE Pillar 1 when the tenant operates as an Administering Entity or Medicaid partner.
rules.remediationGuidance: Tag consumer-facing services with pillar:engage and enrollment-channel in services[].Tags; describe consent and disclosure touchpoints in metadata.ChangeDescription.

frameworkMappings.theme: ACA AE Pillars — Pillar 1: Engage consumers and enable informed enrollment decisions
Thematic architecture-review mapping; not CMS conformity, SSPP authoring, or legal classification.

rules.title: End-to-end enrollment workflow boundaries mapped across systems
rules.description: Architecture must trace the seamless enrollment path from identity proofing through plan selection, subsidy determination, and issuer handoff — including every partner entity that touches applicant data.
rules.remediationGuidance: Map enrollment stages on relationships[] between eligibility, enrollment hub, and issuer integration services; document handoff contracts in governance.PolicyConstraints.

frameworkMappings.theme: ACA AE Pillars — Pillar 2: Seamless experience and end-to-end enrollment
Thematic architecture-review mapping; not CMS conformity, SSPP authoring, or legal classification.

rules.title: Trust, transparency, and accountability controls for Exchange data handling
rules.description: Manifest must show auditability, breach notification paths, and public accountability mechanisms for systems processing FFE/SBE or Medicaid eligibility and enrollment data.
rules.remediationGuidance: Record accountability owners in governance.ComplianceTags; cite audit log destinations and incident escalation in governance.RequiredControls.

frameworkMappings.theme: ACA AE Pillars — Pillar 3: Trust, transparency, and accountability

frameworkMappings.requirement: Audit record review, analysis, and reporting

frameworkMappings.theme: Thematic architecture-review mapping; not CMS conformity, SSPP authoring, or legal classification.

rules.title: Coverage service availability and accessibility architecture documented
rules.description: Enrollment and plan-shopping surfaces must document resilience targets, regional failover, and accessibility accommodations so coverage remains available during open enrollment peaks.
rules.remediationGuidance: State RTO/RPO expectations in governance.PolicyConstraints; tag availability-tier on critical services[].Tags; align multi-region posture with azureExtractor inventory.

frameworkMappings.theme: ACA AE Pillars — Pillar 4: Accessibility and availability of coverage
Thematic architecture-review mapping; not CMS conformity, SSPP authoring, or legal classification.

rules.title: Federal regulatory compliance architecture for ACA and Medicaid obligations
rules.description: Systems in scope for ARC-AMPE must document how architecture supports HIPAA, 45 CFR Part 155, Medicaid IT standards, and CMS security/privacy contract clauses — without asserting legal classification.
rules.remediationGuidance: List applicable regulatory tags in governance.ComplianceTags; map control inheritance from platform to tenant workloads in metadata.ChangeDescription.

frameworkMappings.theme: ACA AE Pillars — Pillar 5: Compliance with federal laws and regulations
Thematic architecture-review mapping; not CMS conformity, SSPP authoring, or legal classification.

rules.remediationGuidance: Describe architecture review and threat modeling gates in governance.RequiredControls; tag experimental integrations with innovation:review-pending on services[].Tags.

frameworkMappings.theme: ACA AE Pillars — Pillar 6: Drive innovation with governed change
Thematic architecture-review mapping; not CMS conformity, SSPP authoring, or legal classification.
